definition: your opinion of someone when you meet them
description: An opening night in an art gallery with white brick walls, spotlights and a big blue and orange painting. A young man in a grey suit and mustard scarf has just met a young woman in a cream coat, red beret and checked skirt; he leans in eagerly with his arms open, but she laughs and holds him back at arm's length with one hand on his chest. Behind them a young woman in a red top covers her eyes in embarrassment, and other guests stand around.

en.question: What is the woman in cream doing?

de.answer: Sie wehrt sich gegen eine peinliche Umarmung.
phrases: sich gegen eine peinliche Umarmung wehren
de.question: Was macht die Frau in Cremeweiß?

es.answer: Se está resistiendo a un abrazo incómodo.
phrases: encogerse de vergüenza detrás de la mano
